name: kie-ai-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Kie.ai integrations: MCP server and standalone CLI sharing a common core

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/core && npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/openai-server && npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/mcp && npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/cli
scripts.bundle: npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/core && npm run build -w @kie-ai-tool/openai-server && npm run bundle -w @kie-ai-tool/mcp && npm run bundle -w @kie-ai-tool/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kie-ai-tool/core && npm run test -w @kie-ai-tool/openai-server && npm run test -w @kie-ai-tool/mcp && npm run test -w @kie-ai-tool/cli && npm run pricing:refresh:test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kie-ai-tool/core && npm run typecheck -w @kie-ai-tool/openai-server && npm run typecheck -w @kie-ai-tool/mcp && npm run typecheck -w @kie-ai-tool/cli

author: Andre Tansil (https://github.com/tansilandre)
